mapper.select:
select * from eg_impairment_provision_detail eipd where eipd.del_flag ='0'
and eipd.contract_code = #{queryDTO.contractCode}::text
and eipd.client_name = #{queryDTO.clientName}::text
and eipd.org_id = #{queryDTO.orgId}::text
and eipd.impairment_type = #{queryDTO.impairmentType}::text
and eipd.business_type = #{queryDTO.businessType}::text
and date_trunc('month', eipd.create_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month')

select * from eg_impairment_provision_detail eipd where eipd.del_flag ='0'
and eipd.excel_type = #{excelType}::text
and date_trunc('month', eipd.create_time) = date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month')

select eoc.org_name , '1221.04' as accountCode, '应收诉讼保全费' as accountName, ecbl.contract_code, ea.assist_flags, ec.client_name, '人民币' as currencyName, ecbl.receivable_litigation_expenses_balance as amount, ecbl.voucher_date, ((date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '1 day')::date - voucher_date::date)::integer AS aging from eg_contract_balance_latest ecbl left join eg_org_company eoc on ecbl.org_id=eoc.org_id and eoc.del_flag='0' left join eg_account ea on ea.account_code='1221.04' and ea.del_flag ='0' left join eg_contract_month ec on ecbl.contract_code =ec.contract_code and ecbl.client_code =ec.client_code and ecbl.org_id =ec.org_id and ec.del_flag ='0' where ecbl.del_flag ='0' and receivable_litigation_expenses_balance != 0

select t.*, case when t.aging>365 then '一年以上' when t.aging>180 then '半年到一年' when t.aging>60 then '三-六个月' when t.aging>30 then '两个月' when t.aging>0 then '一个月' end as agingGroup from ( select eoc.org_name , ecbl.contract_code, ec.client_name, SUBSTRING(ecbl.period_code::text FROM 1 FOR 4) AS periodYear, SUBSTRING(ecbl.period_code::text FROM 5 FOR 2) AS periodMonth, '1122.08' as accountCode, '其他应收款项' as accountName, ecbl.receivable_other_balance as amount, ecbl.voucher_date, ((date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '1 day')::date - voucher_date::date)::integer AS aging from eg_contract_balance_latest ecbl left join eg_org_company eoc on ecbl.org_id=eoc.org_id and eoc.del_flag='0' left join eg_contract_month ec on ecbl.contract_code =ec.contract_code and ecbl.client_code =ec.client_code and ecbl.org_id =ec.org_id and ec.del_flag ='0' where ecbl.del_flag ='0' and receivable_other_balance != 0 ) t

select t.*, case when t.aging>365 then '一年以上' when t.aging>180 then '半年到一年' when t.aging>60 then '三-六个月' when t.aging>30 then '两个月' when t.aging>0 then '一个月' end as agingGroup from ( select '财务中台' as systemReport, ecbl.contract_code, ec.contract_name, SUBSTRING(ecbl.period_code::text FROM 1 FOR 4) AS periodYear, SUBSTRING(ecbl.period_code::text FROM 5 FOR 2) AS periodMonth, '1221.13' as accountCode, '投资性房地产应收租金' as accountName, ecbl.receivable_rent_investment_property_balance as amount, ecbl.voucher_date, ((date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '1 day')::date - voucher_date::date)::integer AS aging from eg_contract_balance_latest ecbl left join eg_contract_month ec on ecbl.contract_code =ec.contract_code and ecbl.org_id =ec.org_id and ec.del_flag ='0' where ecbl.del_flag ='0' and receivable_rent_investment_property_balance != 0 ) t

select t.*, ec.contract_name , ec.client_name , t.receivable_rent_balance + t.receivable_residual_value_balance + t.receivable_outtax_balance - t.unrealized_revenue_balance as boolValue from ( select ecbl.contract_code , ecbl.org_id , sum(receivable_rent_balance) as receivable_rent_balance, sum(receivable_residual_value_balance) as receivable_residual_value_balance, sum(receivable_outtax_balance) as receivable_outtax_balance, sum(unrealized_revenue_balance) as unrealized_revenue_balance from eg_contract_balance_latest ecbl where ecbl.del_flag ='0' and ecbl.org_id in ('01-C0001','01-C0001-old') and ecbl.contract_code like 'D%' and (ecbl.receivable_rent_balance !=0 or ecbl.receivable_residual_value_balance !=0 or ecbl.receivable_outtax_balance!=0 or ecbl.unrealized_revenue_balance!=0) group by ecbl.contract_code ,ecbl.org_id )t left join eg_contract_month ec on t.contract_code =ec.contract_code and t.org_id =ec.org_id and ec.del_flag ='0'

select * from ( select ecbl.org_id, eoc.org_name , ecbl.contract_code, ec.contract_name, SUBSTRING(ecbl.period_code::text from 1 for 4) as periodYear, SUBSTRING(ecbl.period_code::text from 5 for 2) as periodMonth, '长期应收款' as accountName, (coalesce(ecbl.receive_sum_debt_restructure_balance, 0) - coalesce(ecbl.unrealized_revenue_debt_restructure_balance, 0) + coalesce(ecbl.receivable_outtax_debt_restructure_balance, 0) - coalesce(ecbl.other_long_margin_balance, 0) - coalesce(ecbl.unrealized_revenue_other_debt_restructure_balance, 0)) as amount from eg_contract_balance_latest ecbl left join eg_org_company eoc on ecbl.org_id = eoc.org_id and eoc.del_flag = '0' left join eg_contract_month ec on ecbl.contract_code = ec.contract_code and ecbl.client_code = ec.client_code and ecbl.org_id = ec.org_id and ec.del_flag = '0' where ecbl.del_flag = '0' ) t where t.amount != 0

select eipd.id, eipd.contract_code, eipd.impairment_type, eipd.business_type, eipd.org_id, eipd.five_class, eipd.three_step, eipd.risk_exposure, eipd.provision_total, eipd.last_month_balance, eipd.this_month_provision, eipd.voucher_id, eipd.account_date, eipd.del_flag, eipd.create_by, eipd.create_time, eipd.update_by, eipd.update_time, eipd.is_verification, eipd.rent_receivable_balance, eipd.hub_rent_receivable_balance, (case when eipd.client_code is not null then eipd.client_code else (case when eipd.client_name is not null then ( select ec.client_code from eg_contract_month ec where ec.contract_code = eipd.contract_code and ec.org_id = eipd.org_id and ec.del_flag = '0' and ec.client_name = eipd.client_name order by ec.create_time desc limit 1 ) else ( select ec.client_code from eg_contract_month ec where ec.contract_code = eipd.contract_code and ec.org_id = eipd.org_id and ec.del_flag = '0' order by ec.create_time desc limit 1 ) end) end ) client_code, (case when eipd.client_name is not null then eipd.client_name else (case when eipd.client_code is not null then ( select ec.client_name from eg_contract_month ec where ec.contract_code = eipd.contract_code and ec.org_id = eipd.org_id and ec.del_flag = '0' and ec.client_code = eipd.client_code order by ec.create_time desc limit 1 ) else ( select ec.client_name from eg_contract_month ec where ec.contract_code = eipd.contract_code and ec.org_id = eipd.org_id and ec.del_flag = '0' order by ec.create_time desc limit 1 ) end) end ) client_name, ( select ec.financial_contract_status from eg_contract_month ec where ec.contract_code = eipd.contract_code and ec.org_id = eipd.org_id and ec.del_flag = '0' order by ec.create_time desc limit 1 ) financial_contract_status, eipd.contract_name, eipd.excel_type, eipd.error_info, eipd.impairment_provision_id, eipd.target_amount, eipd.exchange_rate, eipd.origin_currency, eipd.target_currency, eipd.financial_institution, eipd.history_flag, eipd.import_flag from eg_impairment_provision_detail eipd where eipd.del_flag ='0' and eipd.account_date is not null and exists ( select 1 from eg_impairment_provision t2 where t2.id = eipd.impairment_provision_id and t2.write_off_original_id is null and COALESCE(t2.is_write_off, '0') != '1')
and eipd.excel_type = #{excelType}::text
and to_char(eipd.account_date , 'YYYYMM') = #{periodCode}::text
